issues.on_page: Debt Service Fund: Local Receipts Local 1,082,441
issues.issue: The Debt Service Fund's local revenue is almost entirely special assessments: Exhibit E (p4) shows Debt Service special assessments of 1,051,658, about 97% of this line. The rules require the dominant category when one is more than half, so this should be special assessments with review ('broad group'), not other/miscellaneous.

issues.on_page: Debt Service Fund: Other Financing Uses 2,057,754
issues.issue: Exhibit E (p4) shows no transfers out of the Debt Service Fund; its 2,238,128 of expenditures are debt service and lease/bond payments. So this budget-basis 'Other Financing Uses' is almost certainly debt service spending, not a transfer. It is already in decision_needed.

Kept unsplit. A full split isn't printed, but the General Fund's 4,158,810 share is broken down on p10 (property 1,493,432, motor vehicle 148,233, sales 2,491,768, occupation 25,377), and the Street and Debt Service sales tax shows on p8. A partial split is possible; this goes to review either way.

issues.on_page: Cash and Cash Equivalents 15,919,300; Cash with Fiscal Agent 190,179; Equity in Pooled Cash and Investments 3,452,807
issues.issue: Uses only the cash and cash equivalents line. The rule says 'cash and cash equivalents/investments', so including pooled cash and investments (3,452,807) is arguable. The notes say what was excluded.

issues.on_page: Capital Contributions (512,812); Statement of Activities p2 'Transfers of Capital (512,812)'
issues.issue: The General Fund's 512,812 capital contribution to the Sewer fund is labelled a transfer of capital on p2. It is recorded as governmental other_financing and business-type other_financing rather than as transfers_out / transfers_net. The two sides are consistent, but it's a classification call.

issues.on_page: Bookmobile and Police Reimbursement 109,263; Economic Development Reimbursement 20,000 (detail[5], detail[6])
issues.issue: These are printed under Intergovernmental Revenues but labelled 'Reimbursement'. reimbursements/refunds is arguable.
This is probably sales tax collected and owed to the state, which would make it due to other governments.
